record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare NATURAL_GIFT in this production reference (CHERUBI has passive NONE; CHERRIM and CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT have passive BLOSSOM). The strategy is shared; differences are the star count.
record.summary: Selects the team entity with the lowest hp/maxHP FRACTION (not the lowest absolute hp; the caster is eligible; a tie keeps the first board entry), requests a heal on it and THEN gives it Rune Protect (the heal runs before Rune Protect and so before its cooldown clearing). The heal is a requested 30/60/90 (raw, by stars 1/2/3; 150 for 4 or more) with AP scaling (apBoost 1) and the cast's crit flag; rune protect lasts 1000/2000/3000 ms (6000 for 4+) and its trigger clears the target's listed negative statuses. If the target is wounded the HP heal is 0 (under BLOODMOON weather with a Blood Stone the wound branch requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw heal)) instead, with the recipient as shield caster) but the Rune Protect is still applied. handleHeal is called in this order (core-mechanics.md section J2): the wound branch first - a wounded recipient gets no HP, but with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by its player the same call requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw requested heal), recipient, apBoost, crit) with the recipient as the shield's caster, which the entity addShield (Big Eater Belt) turns into the final shield; then the guard hp > 0 && !status.protect (an unwounded Protected recipient gets nothing; Rune Protect alone does not block); then the modifiers (AP, crit, BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3, burn x0.5, enraged x0.5, ZENITH x1.2), Math.round and the cap at missing HP; the post-modifier overheal on a Grass-synergy recipient requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal), which also raises current HP. 'No direct HP healing' therefore does not mean 'no shield or max-HP / current-HP effect'. Requested amount, handleHeal's returned healReceived / overheal and the final stored hp / maxHP / shield are three different things. Because the heal precedes triggerRuneProtect, whose clearNegativeStatus only zeroes cooldowns, the existing wound AND burn flags are still set when the heal runs and remain set afterwards until their own updates (a burning target's heal is halved). The Rune Protect timer is only raised when the new duration is longer than the remaining one (an existing longer timer is kept). The default cast animation is suppressed and a custom one aimed at the chosen ally is broadcast.

targeting.who: the board entity of the caster's team with the lowest hp/maxHP; ties keep the first in board.cells order (row-major index columns x y) because the sort is stable; no target is passed to the strategy (target null)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false, so the cast fires from the moving state without an enemy in range. board.cells is filtered with cell && cell.team === pokemon.team: the caster itself and every living team entity count; whether dead entities are removed from cells before this runs was not traced. If no entity matches (the caster is always on the board while casting) nothing is healed.

geometry.shape: single ally anywhere on the board (no range or positional limit)

effects.scaling: requested amount: raw x (1 + 1 x caster.AP / 100), then x caster.critPower only if the cast crit flag is true (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: requested = raw x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if the cast crit, resolved by handleHeal on the chosen ally. handleHeal is called in this order (core-mechanics.md section J2): the wound branch first - a wounded recipient gets no HP, but with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by its player the same call requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw requested heal), recipient, apBoost, crit) with the recipient as the shield's caster, which the entity addShield (Big Eater Belt) turns into the final shield; then the guard hp > 0 && !status.protect (an unwounded Protected recipient gets nothing; Rune Protect alone does not block); then the modifiers (AP, crit, BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3, burn x0.5, enraged x0.5, ZENITH x1.2), Math.round and the cap at missing HP; the post-modifier overheal on a Grass-synergy recipient requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal), which also raises current HP. 'No direct HP healing' therefore does not mean 'no shield or max-HP / current-HP effect'. Requested amount, handleHeal's returned healReceived / overheal and the final stored hp / maxHP / shield are three different things. A full-HP lowest-fraction ally receives 0 HP (the whole modified heal is overheal; a Grass ally then gets addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) with its HP raised too, probe: 30 -> addMaxHP(12), maxHP and HP 112) and the Rune Protect is still applied.

effects.scaling: none from AP or crit (the duration is a fixed table value)
effects.resolution: Status.triggerRuneProtect sets runeProtect = true, clears the listed negative statuses on the ally (clearNegativeStatus: burn, silence, fatigue, poison, freeze, sleep, confusion, wound, paralysis, charm, flinch, armor reduction, curse flag, possession unless from the same team, locked, blind) and raises runeProtectCooldown to the duration only if it is longer than the remaining one (probe: existing 5000 stays 5000 against a new 1000; existing 200 becomes 3000 for 3 stars). It does not pass through applyStatusDurationReductions. The clear happens after the heal request and only zeroes cooldowns: a wounded ally has woundCooldown 0 but its wound FLAG stays true (and a burning ally's burn flag stays true) until updateWound / updateBurn run, so the heal saw the wound or burn and the flags are not cleared immediately afterwards either (probe: wound true / woundCooldown 0; burn true).

statusEffects.applicationOrder: after the heal request, inside the same if (lowestHealthAlly) block, before the animation broadcast
statusEffects.guards: no guard in the strategy; triggerRuneProtect raises the cooldown only when the new duration is longer than the remaining time (a longer existing timer is kept); it does not pass through applyStatusDurationReductions
statusEffects.combatEffect: rune protect makes later status triggers (for example triggerFlinch, which checks runeProtect first) a no-op while active; its full list of effects was not enumerated here (runeProtect appears in 26 places in status.ts and in a few ability files, which were not audited).

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (150 / 6000, also the fallback) is declared in the tables but unused by the three bound baseline classes (stars 1, 2, 3). maxPP is 65 and range 3 for all three. CHERRIM and CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT carry passive BLOSSOM, which only transforms between the two forms with the spotlight and does not change the cast.

record.positionalConditions: None. The target is chosen by hp ratio over the whole team; no range or line is involved.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast re-evaluates the lowest ratio; a second rune protect only extends the timer if its duration is longer than the remaining time.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: heal 30/60/90 (1/2/3 stars) and rune protect 1000/2000/3000 ms. Requested heal = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x critPower on a crit]; the applied HP change is that value after wound, protect, the heal modifiers and the cap at missing HP (0 on a full-HP or wounded target). The rune protect duration (requested 1000 / 2000 / 3000 ms) is not scaled, is applied regardless of the heal result and never shortens a longer existing timer. Requested heal, handleHeal's returned healReceived / overheal and the final stored hp / maxHP / shield (with the Blood Stone addShield and Grass addMaxHP requests) are separate; the wound and burn flags are not cleared by the Rune Protect cleanse in the same call.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence); the moving-state and attacking-state gates were read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate in castAbility was read
Everything runeProtect blocks in combat beyond the cited status triggers

Consulted for the heal helpers: PokemonState.handleHeal / addShield, PokemonEntity.addShield / addMaxHP and Status.clearNegativeStatus / triggerRuneProtect at the pinned commit, and core-mechanics.md section J
unresolved: Whether dead entities can still sit in board.cells when the filter runs (they would be eligible with hp 0 / maxHP ratio 0 and then receive no heal); not traced
Whether applyStatusDurationReductions or other effects shorten the rune protect duration: triggerRuneProtect does not call it, but other code reading runeProtectCooldown was not enumerated
The remaining effects of runeProtect elsewhere in combat (only the flinch trigger guard and clearNegativeStatus were read)
Whether any item or synergy effect changes NATURAL_GIFT beyond what is listed
Which units hold the CHERRIM / CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT forms at runtime depends on the spotlight; only the declared catalog stars are modelled

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (handleHeal, addShield, addMaxHP, clearNegativeStatus, triggerRuneProtect) and the real NaturalGiftStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units, boards and call targets (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, sections SHARED_HELPERS and IMPORT_RECHECK_2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed: 50/1000 is chosen over 40/100 (fraction, not absolute hp); a 4/400 caster heals itself; a wounded ally under Blood Moon with a stone gets no HP and addShield(9) and afterwards still has wound true (cooldown 0); a burning ally gains 15 of 30 and keeps burn true; an unwounded Protected ally is not healed but gets Rune Protect; Rune Protect timers: 5000 kept, 200 raised to 3000; a full-HP Grass ally gets overheal 30 and addMaxHP(12).
